products.name: Nitrile Examination – Standard
products.subtext: Powder-free blue examination gloves built for consistent, everyday protection in clinical, janitorial, and hygiene workflows.
products.description: Designed for reliable protection in medical, laboratory, and hygiene environments, LYDUS Standard Series nitrile examination gloves provide exceptional barrier defense against pathogens and contaminants.

intro.headline: Nitrile Examination Gloves
intro.label: 4 mil
intro.body: Balanced stretch, tactile control, and consistent barrier performance for fast-paced clinical environments.
features: Easy to put on and remove, even during busy hours
Doesn't leave residue or powder mess
Gentle on skin for long wear and frequent glove changes

products.name: Black Nitrile – General
products.subtext: A 5 mil black nitrile glove for shop floors, industrial handling, food prep, sanitation, and front-of-house presentation.
products.description: A versatile black nitrile glove made for light industrial work, maintenance, food handling, and cleaning teams that need a professional look with dependable grip.

specs.label: Intended Use
specs.value: General purpose, sanitation, and service work.

intro.headline: Black Nitrile Gloves
intro.label: 5 mil
intro.body: Flexible enough for long shifts, strong enough for daily service, maintenance, and shop applications.
features: Strong barrier with a comfortable stretch profile
Professional black finish hides stains and product residue
Dependable grip for cleaning, prep, and light industrial tasks

products.name: Black Nitrile – Heavy Duty
products.subtext: An 8 mil heavy-duty glove for mechanics, industrial teams, manufacturing, and demanding handling conditions.
products.description: Built for tougher environments, LYDUS Heavy Duty black nitrile gloves deliver added thickness, durability, and puncture resistance when standard exam gloves are not enough.

specs.label: Intended Use
specs.value: Industrial, mechanical, and heavy handling tasks.

intro.headline: Black Nitrile Gloves

intro.body: Extra thickness and toughness for mechanics, industrial handling, and high-contact environments.
features: Added puncture resistance for tougher tasks
Durable feel without sacrificing fit and control
Made for grease, grime, and demanding industrial use
